name: io.github.yempik-ai/mail-gateway
title: Yempik Mail Gateway
description: Self-hosted MCP server for Gmail, Microsoft 365 and Zoho Mail with draft-first delivery.

gateway_url.description: Base URL of your own deployment, for example https://mail.example.com. There is no public endpoint: you host the gateway yourself.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: HTTP Basic credentials of an MCP client, as base64(MCP_CLIENT_ID:MCP_CLIENT_SECRET). Clients that support OAuth can use the OAuth flow instead.
